name: ats-cv-builder
description: Open-source ATS-friendly resume builder. Fill a form, pick a template and font, download PDF.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/cv-schema && npm run build -w packages/templates
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -k -n schema,templates "npm run dev -w packages/cv-schema" "npm run dev -w packages/templates"
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n schema,templates,web,server -c gray,gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/cv-schema" "npm run dev -w packages/templates" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
